PCA scree plot

Source: R/visualization.R
plot_pca_scree.Rd

Shows eigenvalues per component with a Kaiser line at 1.0 to help determine how many components to retain.

Usage

plot_pca_scree(pca_result)

Arguments

pca_result

Result from jtbd_pca()

Value

A ggplot object

See also

Other clustering: jtbd_cluster(), jtbd_cluster_profile(), jtbd_feature_matrix(), jtbd_find_k(), jtbd_pca(), jtbd_profile_segments(), jtbd_segment(), plot_cluster_heatmap(), plot_elbow(), plot_pca_biplot(), plot_pca_loadings(), plot_segment_index(), plot_segment_profiles()

Examples

data(jtbd_sample)
pca <- jtbd_pca(jtbd_sample)
#> Feature matrix: 200 respondents x 12 objectives (opportunity scores 1-9).
#> Kaiser rule: retaining 5 components (eigenvalue > 1).
plot_pca_scree(pca)
